name: Weaponized Loss
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 2, bard 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 2, mesmerist 3, psychic 3, shaman 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You instill the target creature with an underlying dread that is enhanced when their allies fall around them. The target takes a -1 penalty to Will saves against emotion effects for the duration whether or not they succeed on their saving throw. On a failed saving throw, if an ally of an affected creature is killed, destroyed, or otherwise incapacitated, the affected creature must make another Will save or take a -1 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls. This penalty lasts until the end of the spell’s duration. On a success the penalty is not imposed, however they will be subject to the Will saving throw the next time an ally is killed, destroyed, or otherwise incapacitated.

If the target witnesses an illusion of a triggering event, they must make a Will save or believe their ally is lost and take a heightened penalty.

If a target creature is affected by the -1 penalty to all their rolls and another falls, the penalty increases to -2 unless they make another saving throw. The next time, the penalty increases to -4. Once the penalty has reached -4, it does not increase any further.

If their ally is revived, awakened, brought back into the fight, or shown to be not lost in the case of an illusion, the penalty is reduced by one step.
